snippet.title: Rabanaz - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A chip-based deckbuilder with plenty of tweaks to cheat your way to victory. Link up upgrades, install modification tubes, and alter the scoring to discover your perfect strategy. Can you outwit the Rabanaz machine? Synergize your gambling strategy: Select and create new chips for your collection. Install vaccuum tubes that alter how the machine works. Discover the best combinations to maximize your chances.
